notesEn: Voice search now works like YouTube: speak and see your words live, with a clear message if mic permission is denied. Document photo scan no longer gets stuck after 'Photo received'.
notesHi: Voice search ab YouTube jaisa chalega: bolte waqt words live dikhenge, aur mic permission na mile to saaf message aayega. Document photo scan ab 'Photo received' par atakega nahi.
